name: TetraDrive
description: TetraDrive splits your signal into four frequency bands and drives each one through its own waveshaper. Shape the lows, mids and highs independently, then blend them back together for anything from subtle warmth to full-on fuzz. Drag the crossovers right on the live spectrum to hear exactly what each band does.
